payload.rationale: The catalog-api Service spec defines targetPort 8080 while the catalog-api Pod containers listen on port 8081 (containerPort catalog-http). This port mismatch causes Endpoints to route traffic to a non-listening port on the pods. Patching the Service targetPort to 8081 restores routing to ready pod backends.
payload.rollback_trigger: HTTP 5xx error rate remains >= 0.001 or p95 latency exceeds 200ms after applying the Service patch.

success_criteria.description: HTTP 5xx rate drops below 0.001 and p95 latency remains below 200ms across 3 consecutive observation windows.

critical_claims.claim: The catalog-api Service in namespace proofix-case-03 was configured with targetPort 8080 while targeting pods with label selector app.kubernetes.io/name: catalog-api.
The catalog-api Deployment and Pods configure containerPort 8081 (named catalog-http), and ConfigMap catalog-nginx configures Nginx to listen on port 8081.
The Endpoints object for catalog-api routed traffic for pod IPs 10.42.0.35 and 10.42.0.36 to port 8080 instead of port 8081.
The catalog-api Service was successfully patched to fix the port configuration.
The service met the SLO with 0.0 error rate and p95 latency below 200ms across three consecutive measurement windows after remediation.

closure.summary: The incident was caused by a targetPort mismatch in the catalog-api Service, which forwarded traffic to port 8080 instead of the container listening port 8081. Patching the Service targetPort resolved the routing failure, restoring availability and satisfying the SLO across three consecutive evaluation windows.
